summary: Vizsla Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing the immediate replacement of Corporate Secretary Jen Hanson by Susy Horna. The change is effective May 12, 2026. No transaction terms, consideration, or advisors are disclosed. This is a non-routine officer departure tied to the corporate secretary role. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under the 1934 Act. Watch for any further board-level or C-suite changes that may signal governance shifts.
